This bartender worked at the [[Binary Bar]] on [[Venaari]]. He worked with the local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell. He was killed when a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] arrived to arrest [[Shandria L'hnnar]]. The bartender fired on the group with a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] loaded with [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]] but was killed while reloading.<ref name="AJ5" />
